description: This file implements functions for parsing and handling touchpad configuration flags within the Cuttlefish project, including parsing individual touchpad configs from string flags and aggregating multiple configs from command-line arguments.

methods.name: ParseTouchpadConfig
methods.description: Parses a single touchpad configuration string into a TouchpadConfig object, validating presence of width and height and converting string values to integers.

methods.name: ParseTouchpadConfigsFromArgs
methods.description: Parses multiple touchpad configuration flags from command-line arguments into a vector of TouchpadConfig objects.
